name: Ahasolar Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Ahasolar Technologies Ltd provides multiple digital solutions and advisory in the field of renewable energy[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) ASTL is a DPIIT recognised startup for CleanTech enabling Energy Transition through Digital Transformation
b) It is in the business of providing solutions and advisory for solar renewable energy
c) Company has developed an AI based intelligent Solar Digital Platform.
d) It works in Climate Change, Renewable and Digital space

cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.71 Cr.
